label: Tenant offboarding SLA
seo_title: RunMyCampus — tenant offboarding and data custody SLA
seo_description: How schools export data, request closure, and receive operator-gated wind-down with grace periods and signed deletion certificates.
headline: Tenant offboarding you can trust.
subheadline: School administrators export portability packs and submit offboarding requests. Platform operators approve wind-down, enforce legal holds, and execute permanent purge only after gated review.

segments.title: Export first
segments.body: Full portability ZIP with student JSON, canonical CSV domains, and a switching pack README before any closure is approved.

segments.title: Operator approval
segments.body: By default tenants cannot self-delete. School admins submit a request; RunMyCampus operators approve or reject before wind-down and grace scheduling.

segments.title: Grace and purge
segments.body: Configurable grace period (default 30 days). Auto-purge is opt-in per deployment. Dual approval and billing clearance gates apply when enabled.

segments.title: Deletion certificate
segments.body: Completed purges emit an HMAC-signed deletion certificate verifiable via our public API — audit logs are retained separately per contract.

segments.title: Individual rights
segments.body: Parents may download child-specific exports and submit erasure requests from the parent portal; school admins use the GDPR export and DSAR flows.
